title: Big-Data-Project (Predictive Power Generation)
summary: A university big-data course project exploring predictive modeling for power generation, which includes notebooks that generate and evaluate synthetic tabular data. The 'Synthetic Data Vault.ipynb' notebook imports SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer, builds metadata, fits and samples synthetic data, and runs SDV's diagnostic and quality-evaluation functions.
